summary: Verified 3 minor UI validation fixes from iteration 8: blur-based inline validation on /profile password change and /users add/edit dialog + toast-success data-testid. All 8 blur validation scenarios showed correct inline errors with the exact data-testids specified. Toast success confirmed on both user create and profile save flows. Backend regression skipped (iteration 8 backend 100%).
seed_data_creation: Created test user 'testqa762632' via /users dialog to verify save flow; deleted afterwards via php artisan tinker (\App\Models\User::where('username','like','testqa%')->delete()). Zulfame password unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 verified: (1) /profile Ubah Kata Sandi blur validations all fire correctly at [data-testid=profile-password-{current,new,confirm}-error]. Exact messages: 'Kolom kata sandi saat ini wajib diisi.', 'Kata sandi baru minimal 8 karakter.', 'Konfirmasi kata sandi tidak cocok.'. (2) /users Tambah dialog blur validations all fire correctly at [data-testid=user-form-{name,username,email,phone,password}-error]. (3) User save works end-to-end: filled valid fields (name, username, email=testqa*@example.test, phone=081234567890, password=password123, default role Staf) → clicked [data-testid=user-form-save] → [data-testid=toast-success] appeared and DB confirmed row created (id=30). (4) Profile save regression: clicked [data-testid=profile-save] with unchanged valid data → [data-testid=toast-success] appeared. (5) Note: user is defaulted to Member Area (Dashboard+Profil sidebar) after login; /appearance and /storage-settings are in Administrator area and require area switch — regression of those pages was not executed in this iteration but backend tests iteration 8 covered them 100%. (6) Login rate limit is real (5 failed attempts) — after several test runs cache:clear on adminkit may be needed to reset throttles. (7) 5 unrelated console 403 errors observed (likely favicon/manifest asset probing), no functional impact.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all fixes verified working as intended.
